tables.user:
CREATE TABLE `user` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('admin','teacher','student') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `student_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii DEFAULT NULL,
  `teacher_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_user_email` (`email`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_user_student` (`student_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_user_teacher` (`teacher_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_student` FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `student` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_teacher` FOREIGN KEY (`teacher_id`) REFERENCES `teacher` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `user` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('admin','teacher','student') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `student_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `teacher_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `fiscal_code_hmac` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `fiscal_code_hmac_key_id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `fiscal_code_enc` varbinary(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fiscal_code_enc_key_id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `lifecycle_state` enum('Active','Closed') CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Active',
  `closed_at_utc` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reactivated_at_utc` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_user_email` (`email`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_user_student` (`student_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_user_teacher` (`teacher_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_user_fiscal_code_hmac` (`fiscal_code_hmac`),
  KEY `idx_user_lifecycle` (`lifecycle_state`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_student` FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `student` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_teacher` FOREIGN KEY (`teacher_id`) REFERENCES `teacher` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.identity_lifecycle_event:
CREATE TABLE `identity_lifecycle_event` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `transition` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `rule_code` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `rule_version` int NOT NULL,
  `security_generation` bigint NOT NULL,
  `occurred_at_utc` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_lifecycle_transition` (`user_id`,`transition`,`security_generation`),
  KEY `idx_lifecycle_user_time` (`user_id`,`occurred_at_utc`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_lifecycle_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
